newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major says Labour will sell out country to EU.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major says Labour will sell out country to EU.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major accused the opposition Labour party of planning to sell out British interests at the Amsterdam summit of the European Union in June if it wins the May 1 election.
Speaking to a crowd in the northwestern town of Carlisle, Major said: "The Labour party have made it clear they will go to Amsterdam for a Dutch auction of British interests."
A Dutch auction is a public sale of goods where the auctioneer reduces the price until a buyer is found.
Major said Labour would surrender six times to its European partners within six weeks of the election.
"They will give up the veto in area after area after area. They will sign the employment chapter so we shall import European levels of unemployment into this country," he said.

Major said the EU's Social Chapter was "an empty box at the moment" but added that if Labour signed up to it, the party would have to bring in European-style social provisions which would make it tougher for employers to take on new workers.
